static_traits.name: Zhang Cheng
static_traits.family_status: Has supportive friends and family, but not yet discussing this issue with them
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; never received counseling or therapy; previously no similar travel-plan problem experiences
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good organization; tending toward negative self-evaluation and overgeneralization; Good cooperation in counseling

basic_info.main_problem: Due to needing to cancel round-trip air tickets from schedule conflicts, and not yet purchasing trip-cancellation insurance, feeling overwhelmed and Increased stress; also self-perceiving difficulty in effectively planning travel.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking counseling due to being overwhelmed and lacking confidence, hoping to develop effective Coping strategies.

core_beliefs: I am not good at planning and organizing

special_situations.event: Needing to cancel round-trip air tickets due to schedule conflicts and not yet purchasing cancellation insurance, facing obvious financial loss
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot arrange the trip perfectly and foresee all changes, it equals total failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids planning travel again, reduces travel-related decisions to avoid making mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I messed things up, I am not good at planning

special_situations.event: Whenever thinking about planning a trip again
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I try planning a trip again, I will inevitably forget important items or book the wrong dates
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Choosing avoidance and procrastination, to reduce Anxiety and risk
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will definitely mess up again

special_situations.event: Frequent Self-doubt when facing daily decisions (not limited to travel)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot get it right in one go, it proves I am unreliable and insufficiently capable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeated hesitation and second-guessing reduce action and decision-making

special_situations.event: Recalls that a few past trips went reasonably well
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Positive experiences do not count, success is just luck, cannot show I am capable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating past effective practices and successful experiences, not integrating them
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: That was just luck, cannot show I can do it

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen as capable, in control of plans and decisions
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure again and being proven incompetent, leading to financial loss and intensified Self-deprecation
defense_goal: Reducing Anxiety and potential losses through avoiding attempts and Self-denial
Staying cautious to avoid making mistakes again

object_relations.object_representation: A strict external world that easily punishes mistakes (such as ticketing and scheduling)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When counseling discusses formulating an action plan or suggests trying travel planning again
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The subconscious understands 'trying again' as inevitable failure and Increased stress (believing any plan will go wrong)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Cautious but not overly oppositional tone, acknowledging the client's concerns while gently pointing out existing evidence of success; use concrete facts for Questioning and Empathetic reflection, avoiding blame.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about past successful experiences and exploring their reusable strategies
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Attributing success to luck, negating the role of own ability and methods
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintaining a supportive and curious tone, inviting examples of specific practices; using open questions to Guide identification of replicable steps, avoiding confrontation.

manifestations: Experiencing the pressure of choice and uncertainty when facing travel and daily decisions, hard to bear sense of responsibility
Tending to reduce choice-related Anxiety through avoidance

contact_model.definition: The individual has unhealthy self-Reflection and excessive self-restriction, self-reproach, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequent Self-doubt and second-guessing ('I cannot get anything right')
Generalizing a single failure into universal incompetence
Worrying during action-plan discussions that 'failure would prove I am a failure'

contact_model.definition: The individual redirects energy originally meant to be directed outward toward oneself, restraining help-seeking from others or outward action.
manifestations: Knowingly having supportive friends and family but not yet discussing this issue with them
Internalizing pressure and Anxiety, reducing outward help-seeking and action

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact.
manifestations: Turning to catastrophic Anticipation and Self-denial during concrete strategy discussions
Uses 'might fail' as a reason to avoid facing planning steps directly

exception_events.target_problem: When planning travel, the client usually feels overwhelmed and avoids action, producing catastrophic Anticipation and Self-denial, leading to decision paralysis.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Several past trips went okay; in those situations, the client planned ahead and double-checked details, resulting in smoother processes and lower Anxiety.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: planning ahead, double-checking details; lower situational load: fewer items to handle at the time, easier to manage.

positive_force: Has had several smooth travel experiences
Willing to try cognitive restructuring and action plans
Able to identify own thinking patterns (overgeneralization, personalization)
negative_force: Prominent catastrophizing and overgeneralization thinking, tending to negate positive evidence
Avoiding plans and decisions, not yet effectively using the support system

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding or delaying travel planning and related decisions
antecedent: Thinking about needing to plan a trip again
Facing the pressure of canceled flights and financial loss
Worries about booking the wrong date or missing important items
target_behavior.core_reason: A single failure and financial loss triggered negative core beliefs about own capability and cognitive distortions (overgeneralization, catastrophizing), leading to declining Self-efficacy.
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential mistakes and losses to gain short-term safety and emotional relief
target_behavior.consequence: Travel and related matters stagnating, Limited opportunities; Anxiety persisting and spilling into daily decisions.

target_behavior.behavior: Repeated Self-doubt and second-guessing when making decisions
antecedent: Recalls the negative experience of a recent trip cancellation
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizing one failure into universal incompetence, emotional reasoning Reinforcing distrust of own judgment.
target_behavior.function: Trying to reduce mistake risk and Anxiety through constant checking and hesitation
target_behavior.consequence: Decision-making efficiency significantly declines, daily life is affected, pressure accumulates.

target_behavior.behavior: Negating past successful experiences (attributing them to luck)
antecedent: Being asked about past smooth travel experiences
When trying to summarize replicable strategies
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative self-schema and cognitive biases (negating positive evidence) maintaining low Self-efficacy
target_behavior.function: Maintaining the existing self-narrative to avoid taking responsibility for trying and changing
target_behavior.consequence: Unable to integrate effective strategies, changing Decreased motivation, problem maintained.
